notes: Ibuprofen is widely available OTC in the US.
guidance: Nurofen contains ibuprofen. In the US the same active ingredient is sold as ibuprofen (brands: Advil, Motrin); ask the pharmacist for it by that name.
disclaimer: Same active ingredient does not mean the same product: strength, form and excipients can differ. Confirm with a pharmacist. Not medical advice.
